overlap.method: Complete paginated GitHub REST inventory of open pull requests and repository discussions; title/body search plus inspection of nearest prior T16 results.
overlap.snapshot: evidence/OVERLAP.json; 350 open PRs and 321 discussion records returned by the API.
overlap.finding: No open PR for this T16 multi-role owner-packing improvement. Nearest work is distinct: Discussion #1332 / closed PR #1343 exactly censused single whole-helper moves and found no legal strictly improving one-role relocation, explicitly excluding multi-role repacking; this contribution changes multiple owner rows jointly and passes full replay. Discussion #1265 / closed PR #1276 bounded within-group repartitions of the selected map’s unhosted idle rank-48 children (kappa ceiling 0.001673151843213755, no admitted gain); this full owner repack reaches 0.001673618490895016 by changing hosted-helper placements and the aggregate idle profile. Discussion #1339 / PR #1387 priced a structural idle-axis optimum but its overlay failed the actual stream-composition check. Open PR #1807 certifies selected owner-row bindings in Lean, and #3209 changes T16 audit parsing; neither changes the packing.
overlap.added_value: An exact-replayed, multi-row legal owner-map improvement beyond the single-relocation census and idle-only repartition domains, with exact pricing and independent controls.
overlap.limits: A matching title or nearby scoped result is not proof of global novelty; this claim is restricted to the fixed selected word and supplier.

interpretation.word_ceiling: ceiling.ceiling() gives a_hi = 0.001690054109089; under kappa < a/(1+a), the kappa ceiling is about 0.001687202645325402.
interpretation.proved_packing_ceiling: The unchanged exact checker proves E <= 908139.013 and at most 4,887 empty cap-48 bins; neither statement is a kappa optimality bound.

moment_cost_probe.status: Exploratory local-only negative result; no later OR-Tools search justified by these runs.
moment_cost_probe.idea: On a copy of lns2.py, minimize the separable complex moment contribution f*(73/f)^a per bin at the incumbent endpoint a=0.001676424185410303243034, rounded to integer coefficients; exact supplier pricing decides acceptance.
moment_cost_probe.reproducibility: The copied experimental edit was not retained in the package. These probes are not required to reproduce the shipped map or its verification.

runs.outcome: No strict objective improvement; no candidate accepted.
The candidate had lower exact kappa and was rejected.
Plateau map had the same exact kappa.

moment_cost_probe.conclusion: This small sample does not establish local optimality. It shows no utility for spending more search budget on this objective/neighbourhood combination now.
